Command: engram control-policy set-acceptance-evaluation --help
Read-only CLI usage query; no store was opened or mutated.

Activate the acceptance-evaluation policy: which evaluator modes may record verdicts, what backs a mechanical pass, and whether completion must present a fresh host source fingerprint. An empty mode list restores legacy self-asserted completion through the same audited transition

Usage: engram.exe control-policy set-acceptance-evaluation [OPTIONS] --authorized-by <AUTHORIZED_BY> --reason <REASON> --idempotency-key <IDEMPOTENCY_KEY>

Options:
      --modes [<MODE[,MODE]>...]
          Allowed evaluator modes, comma-separated: same-session, sub-agent, independent-session. Omit for the legacy self-asserted path

      --mechanical-basis <MECHANICAL_BASIS>
          What an observed or asserted mechanical pass may cite

          Possible values:
          - asserted: Agent gate records with no failure labels back a mechanical pass
          - observed: Only host-minted verification evidence with a passed result does

          [default: asserted]

      --require-source-freshness
          Completion must present a source fingerprint equal to the evaluated one

      --authorized-by <AUTHORIZED_BY>
          Host/operator actor id attributed to the policy decision

      --reason <REASON>
          Auditable reason for selecting this policy

      --idempotency-key <IDEMPOTENCY_KEY>
          Durable caller key for exact receipt replay after an uncertain response

      --expected-policy-hash <EXPECTED_POLICY_HASH>
          Optional compare-and-swap guard from `engram doctor`

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')
